notes.binary_harmed_target_definition: 1 when argmin_d loss_t(d) occurs before depth 8; ties go to the earliest depth via argmin.
notes.binary_done_by_depth_3_definition: 1 when the shallowest depth within delta of depth-8 loss is <= 3.
notes.multiclass_definition: 0-based class index for argmin_d loss_t(d), corresponding to depth_1..depth_8.
notes.mlp_trigger_rule: Run MLP when linear-probe test accuracy is less than baseline + mlp_trigger_margin.
